  PROBLEM: The sentence "the autofix and judge-fix limits stop those commits, after which the rounds pile up on one head and the cap applies" overstates what bounds head-moving commits, because `[ai-merge-resolve]` conflict commits and base-sync `update-branch` merges also move the head and are not bounded by those limits.
  WHY: The count filter `$created >= $since[.]` in scripts/review_sweep_round_cap.sh restarts at every new head commit, so a PR that keeps conflicting or being base-synced is never capped, which contradicts the changelog. Severity disagreement: anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 rated it NIT, while minimax_minimax-m3 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash rated it MAJOR. The highest is used.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

The README row, the agents fragment, the helper header and the changelog all state the narrower head-scoped rule, and only the PR description differs. Two reviewers rated this NIT and treated it as a description mismatch, and two rated it MAJOR. The highest severity is MAJOR.

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- changelog.d/9683-review-round-cap-and-generated-chore-skip.md:4 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The sentence overstates what stops head-moving commits. `[ai-merge-resolve]` commits (`scripts/review_conflict_prepare.sh:580`, `:802`) and base-sync `update-branch` merges (`scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:1495`) also move the head, and the autofix and judge-fix limits do not bound them.
  WHY: Every such commit restarts the count in `scripts/review_sweep_round_cap.sh` (`$created >= $since[.]`), so the cap may never apply to those PRs. This is documentation only.
- TASK_GAP:
  Requirement: "A PR whose head is not approved and that has SWEEP_REVIEW_MAX_ROUNDS (default 10) or more rounds in the last SWEEP_REVIEW_ROUND_WINDOW_HOURS (default 48) is not dispatched."
  Expected change site: PR description, which is not repository code. The count itself is in `scripts/review_sweep_round_cap.sh`, `review_sweep_round_counts`.
  Evidence of absence: The code deliberately counts only runs created since the current head commit's committer date. The helper header, the README row, the agents fragment and the changelog state this narrower rule, and only the PR description omits it. This is a description mismatch, not a missing implementation.
  SEVERITY: NIT

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- changelog.d/9683-review-round-cap-and-generated-chore-skip.md:4 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The clause "the autofix and judge-fix limits stop those commits" is false for `[ai-merge-resolve]` commits and merge commits. `scripts/review_autofix_step_count_iterations.sh:100-103` skips them "without resetting the count". `.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:5123-5130` pushes the `[ai-merge-resolve]` commit to the PR branch. `scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:1290-1291` documents that base sync uses GitHub's update-branch merge.
  WHY: Both commit kinds move the head, and the count filter (`scripts/review_sweep_round_cap.sh:164`, `$created >= $since[.]`) restarts at every new head commit. The sweep keeps dispatching such a PR while the changelog says the cap applies.
- TASK_GAP:
  Requirement: "A PR whose head is not approved (`head_gate_state` present and not `success`) and that has `SWEEP_REVIEW_MAX_ROUNDS` (default 10) or more rounds in the last `SWEEP_REVIEW_ROUND_WINDOW_HOURS` (default 48) is not dispatched."
  Expected change site: scripts/review_sweep_round_cap.sh, `review_sweep_round_counts`, and the cap check in `.github/workflows/review_autofix_sweep.yml` ("Enumerate open PRs and dispatch internal-review.yml")
  Evidence of absence: `scripts/review_sweep_round_cap.sh:105-110` builds a per-PR `since` map from the current head commit date, and line 164 keeps only runs created at or after it. Rounds dispatched before the current head commit are discarded even inside the window, so a PR with 30 rounds in 48 hours whose head was committed two hours ago is still dispatched. The narrowing is also defeated by `[ai-merge-resolve]` and update-branch head moves.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
- changelog.d/9683-review-round-cap-and-generated-chore-skip.md:4 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The claim is false for PRs whose head keeps moving via commits not bounded by MAX_AUTOFIX_ITERATIONS or MAX_REVIEW_BLOCKED_RETRIES. Those commits are `[ai-merge-resolve]` conflict commits (scripts/review_conflict_prepare.sh:802, scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh:4796) and base-sync commits from `PUT /pulls/{n}/update-branch` (scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:1494).
  WHY: Each such commit moves the head, and the filter in scripts/review_sweep_round_cap.sh resets the count to zero. A head-churning PR never reaches the cap, and the `ai:needs-human` escalation the changelog implies never fires.
- TASK_GAP:
  Requirement: "A PR whose head is not approved and that has SWEEP_REVIEW_MAX_ROUNDS or more rounds in the last SWEEP_REVIEW_ROUND_WINDOW_HOURS is not dispatched" (PR description; PR title: "Cap dispatched review rounds per PR in the sweep").
  Expected change site: scripts/review_sweep_round_cap.sh, review_sweep_round_counts (count filter `$created >= $since[.]`)
  Evidence of absence: The helper discards rounds created before the current head commit even inside the rolling window, so the delivered behavior is narrower than the description. The editor deferred this earlier as intended design and aligned the README, the agents fragment, the helper header and the changelog. Only the PR description is unaligned, and no diff hunk in this repository can change it.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
